notes: A Lignes d'Azur ticket costs 1.50 EUR (bus and tram), a day pass 5. TER trains run along the coast (Monaco 20 min, Cannes 30 min). Tram 2 goes to the airport.
Summer temperatures are 27-30°C. Beaches are pebbly, so buy beach shoes. Cannes-Antibes trains get crowded; go to Èze and Monaco in the morning. July brings Nice Jazz, and August the French holidays.
Socca 4 EUR, pan bagnat 6, salade niçoise 15, restaurant meals 25-40, museums 10 (Nice museum pass 15 EUR for 3 days); round up the bill as a tip.
Monaco casino is for tourists before 14:00, with a dress code in the evening; visit Èze in the morning; La Colombe d'Or and La Merenda: reserve ahead, and La Merenda takes no phone bookings.
Watch for pickpockets on Tram 1 and at Cours Saleya; never leave your belongings unattended on the beach.
Try Rosé de Provence, pastis and tarte tropézienne; Niçoise cuisine is a mix of Italian and Provençal.

stops.name: Cours Saleya Market
stops.tips: Flower and food market (antiques on Mondays). Try socca (chickpea pancake) at the Chez Thérésa stand, and pan bagnat.

stops.name: Vieux Nice Sokakları
stops.tips: Ochre-coloured Italianate streets; Sainte-Réparate cathedral, and Fenocchio ice cream (100 flavours).

stops.name: Colline du Château
stops.tips: Castle hill with a waterfall and views over the Baie des Anges; free lift (Bellanda Tower).

stops.name: Chez Pipo
stops.tips: Wood-fired socca since 1923, next to Port Lympia; expect a queue.

stops.name: Promenade des Anglais
stops.tips: 7 km seafront boulevard with blue chairs, the Negresco and sunsets. Swim off the pebble beach in summer.

backups.name: Fenocchio Glacier
backups.tips: Lavender, olive and beer ice cream; on Place Rossetti.

backups.name: Palais Lascaris
backups.tips: Baroque palace with musical instruments; in Vieux Nice.

stops.name: Musée National Marc Chagall
stops.tips: 17 paintings of the Biblical Message plus stained glass; in Cimiez, bus 15, closed Tuesdays.

stops.name: Musée Matisse
stops.tips: Red Genoese villa with Matisse's cut-outs; olive grove park (Roman arena).

stops.name: Café Matisse Cimiez
stops.tips: Café in the museum park; try the salade niçoise.

stops.name: Place Masséna
stops.tips: Red square with statues of the 7 continents (lit at night); take the tram.

stops.name: Promenade du Paillon
stops.tips: Park with a water mirror; walk from Masséna to MAMAC.

backups.name: MAMAC
backups.tips: Modern art (Klein, Niki de Saint Phalle); free rooftop terrace.

backups.name: Lou Pilha Leva Vieux Nice
backups.tips: Standing-room socca, pissaladière (onion tart) and beignets.

stops.name: Èze Village
stops.tips: Bus 82/112 (1.50 EUR) or train (Èze-sur-Mer); 1 hour climb on the Nietzsche Path. Medieval eagle's nest village with a Fragonard perfume factory.

stops.name: Monaco Monte-Carlo Casino
stops.tips: Belle Époque casino (entry 19 EUR, visit before 14:00); Café de Paris and Ferraris.

stops.name: Monaco-Ville Rock and Prince's Palace
stops.tips: Old town on the rock; changing of the guard at 11:55, Cathedral (Grace Kelly's tomb).

stops.name: Marché de la Condamine
stops.tips: Monaco's market food hall; barbagiuan (fried pastry) and socca, cheap Monaco.

stops.name: Musée Océanographique
stops.tips: Cousteau's aquarium on a cliff edge; rooftop views.

backups.name: Jardin Exotique de Monaco
backups.tips: Monaco's cactus garden and cave; an alternative to the aquarium.

backups.name: Le Nid d'Aigle Èze
backups.tips: Terrace restaurant at the top of the village.

stops.name: Villefranche-sur-Mer
stops.tips: 7 minutes by train; colourful harbour, Cocteau's Saint-Pierre chapel and the Rue Obscure tunnel.

stops.name: Plage des Marinières
stops.tips: Villefranche's sandy cove; calm swimming.

stops.name: Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild
stops.tips: Pink villa with 9 themed gardens; musical fountains every 20 minutes, and a tea room.

stops.name: Sentier du Littoral Cap Ferrat
stops.tips: Coastal path around the peninsula; Saint-Jean harbour and Paloma beach.

stops.name: Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat Harbour
stops.tips: Harbour café; a billionaires' village among the Rothschild villas.

backups.name: Beaulieu Villa Kérylos
backups.tips: Replica Greek villa by the sea; an alternative to Ephrussi.

stops.name: Antibes Marché Provençal
stops.tips: 25 minutes by train; covered Provençal market with olives and tapenade.

stops.name: Musée Picasso Antibes
stops.tips: Picasso's 1946 studio in the Grimaldi castle; sculptures on the sea terrace.

stops.name: Cannes La Croisette
stops.tips: 10 minutes by train; handprints at the Palais des Festivals, and palm trees.

stops.name: Le Suquet Cannes
stops.tips: Old town hill; lunch near Marché Forville with views of the harbour.

stops.name: Île Sainte-Marguerite
stops.tips: 15-minute ferry; the fortress of the Man in the Iron Mask, pine forest and coves.

stops.name: Saint-Paul-de-Vence
stops.tips: Train to Cagnes plus bus 655; walled artists' village with Chagall's grave, galleries, and pétanque at Café de la Place.

stops.name: Fondation Maeght
stops.tips: Miró labyrinth, Giacometti courtyard and Chagall mosaic; one of Europe's finest modern art foundations.

stops.name: La Colombe d'Or
stops.tips: The inn where Picasso and Matisse left paintings in exchange for meals; terrace (reserve) or café outside the set menu.

stops.name: Vence Chapelle du Rosaire
stops.tips: The chapel Matisse called his masterpiece; check the afternoon opening hours.

stops.name: Vence Old Town
stops.tips: Medieval town with a Chagall mosaic in the cathedral; catch the bus back.

backups.name: Le Tilleul Saint-Paul
backups.tips: Terrace under a linden tree; a good alternative to the Colombe.

backups.name: Renoir Museum Cagnes
backups.tips: Renoir's last home with its olive grove; an alternative to Vence.

stops.name: Plage Beau Rivage Morning Swim
stops.tips: Morning dip off the pebble beach; bring beach shoes.

stops.name: Marché de la Libération
stops.tips: Locals' market (Gare du Sud); pissaladière and cheese.

stops.name: Confiserie Florian
stops.tips: Crystallised flowers and fruit sweets; by the harbour, good for souvenirs.

stops.name: La Merenda
stops.tips: Legendary Niçoise spot with 12 tables, no phone and no cards; daube and stockfish, a farewell meal.

stops.name: Tram 2 to the Airport
stops.tips: Tram 2 reaches the airport in 25 minutes; farewell.

backups.name: Le Safari Cours Saleya
backups.tips: Niçoise classics on the market terrace.

backups.name: Musée Masséna
backups.tips: Belle Époque villa and the history of Nice; on the Promenade.
